packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript on 6.x: TypeScript 7 crashes @typescript-eslint v8 (ESLint: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Cjs')") and breaks astro check. Remove once the toolchain supports it.
Merge bookmarklets bumps as soon as CI passes. git-refs digests have no release timestamp, so skip the shared preset's minimumReleaseAge, which would otherwise hold them.

customManagers.description: Track the benbalter/bookmarklets commit vendored in src/data/bookmarklets.json. Renovate only bumps the commit; CI (script/update-bookmarklets --check) fails if the vendored code needs refreshing.
Track benbalter/vale-styles release zips (BenBalter, AIPatterns) pinned by URL in .vale.ini.
